description:
On 16th October from 2 pm to 4 pm, Rotaract Club of SIES College Sion West in collaboration with our Club organized “Manavoh”, a Stress Buster Session supported by President Rtn Amit Gupta and conceptualized by Rtn Sonal Pangoriya at the College premises.

The Speakers included:

1) Mr Basab Sen a senior disciple of world renowned philosopher Swami Parthasarathy. An alumnus of Vedanta Academy
2) Ms Sneha Singh – trained to use psychometric assessments, interpersonal skills, time management skills, empathy and active listening and commercial skills.
3) Mr Hitesh Ramchandani, Cerebral Palsy kid

Beneficiaries – 100 (70 Rotaractors, 30 Interactors)

Attended by Rtn Sonal Pangoriya

Project cost Rs 3000
